messages:
pagerduty: :rotating_light: PagerDuty triggered for service="inference-serving-eu-west-1". Severity=P1. Symptom: sustained p95 latency > 2s for 10m. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-latency
oncall-bot: Automated page delivered to #infra-oncall and #incidents. Incident ID PD-7342.
maya: acked and taking. standing up to triage, grabbing dashboards and logs. :eyes:
kevin: thanks maya. if autoscaler isn't kicking, check min nodes and burst policy first. i'll pull perf dashboards and check GPU distribution.
maya: quick snapshot: seen three duplicate pages in 2m (two alert rules). will focus on mitigation, file dup-alerts ticket after.
lin: i'm nearby, low context on this pool. maya do you want support on the bridge? i can prepare a temporary rate limit if we need fast shedding.
maya: please join @lin, i'm spinning up an adhoc bridge: meet.redwood/incident-7342
sre-runbook-bot: Runbook suggested steps:
1) kubectl -n inference get pods --selector=app=inference-worker -o wide
2) check queue depth and redis connections
3) inspect model variant fallbacks and KV cache metrics
Command hints:
```
kubectl -n inference get pods -o wide --selector=app=inference-worker
redis-cli -h redis-prod-eu info | grep connected_clients
```
kevin: dashboards show GPU util ~95% on two workers, others idle. autoscaler not firing due to minNodes=2 and burst throttle. p95 token time increased at ~10:12UTC.
maya: looking at logs on worker-7: repeated KV cache miss churn and GC spikes, threads blocked. kicking a restart on that pod to clear state.
pagerduty: PagerDuty: acknowledgement recorded by maya at 2104567905.
lin: rolling restart applied on worker-7 -> node CPU pressure subsiding, queue depth down ~40%. great.
maya: verifying client error rate: 5xx steady, no spike. this is latency/backpressure. top impacted customers last 15m: app_helios, app-scribe with elevated tail latency.
kevin: applying a temporary autoscaler burst: allow +2 nodes for 10m to drain queues. will monitor and revert.
ops-lead: note for follow-up: duplicate alerts from latency and queue-depth rules. add fingerprinting/dedupe until root cause fixed.
maya: autoscaler change in effect. observed p95 drop 2.3s -> 0.9s within two minutes. mitigation looks effective.
lin: reassigning long-term ownership to kevin for autoscaler tuning + alert dedupe. @kevin you own follow-up? :point_right:
kevin: taking follow-up ownership (kevin). will open PRs: autoscaler config + alert dedupe. ETA for PR: 30m.
maya: leaving notes in bridge and runbook: "temp burst +2, restarted worker-7 for GC/KV churn, duplicate alerts observed". handing off.
pagerduty: PagerDuty: incident status acked by maya; follow-up owner=kevin.
ops-lead: customer impact: localized latency degradation in eu-west-1 for ~18 minutes, elevated token usage costs, no data loss. decide on targeted customer comms if flagged.
kevin: follow-up checklist:
- PR: adjust burst policy and add automated tests
- PR: add dedupe fingerprint to latency/queue alerts
- Investigate KV cache churn and GC root cause
sre-runbook-bot: Follow-up links: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/autoscaler-tuning , https://redwood.internal/alerts/guide#dedupe
maya: good work team — i'll update the incident tracker timeline and close the PD once follow-ups are tracked.
kevin: will post PR and tag reviewers, add postmortem card on incidents board.
lin: back to standby. great quick triage. :thumbsup:
ops-lead: closing bridge in 10m if stable, thanks all.
